title: Patterned proliferation orients tissue-wide stress to control root vascular symmetry in Arabidopsis.
authors: Fujiwara, Motohiro; Imamura, Miyu; Matsushita, Katsuyoshi; Roszak, Pawel; Yamashino, Takafumi; Hosokawa, Yoichiroh; Nakajima, Keiji; Fujimoto, Koichi; Miyashima, Shunsuke
one_liner_zh: 该文研究拟南芥根维管发育中GATA转录因子HANABA-TARANU调控细胞增殖与机械应力对称性，虽涉及转录因子和机械模拟，但核心是组织发育而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法上机械模拟非AI/分子动力学，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Symmetric tissue alignment is pivotal to the functions of plant vascular tissue, such as long-distance molecular transport and lateral organ formation. During the vascular development of the Arabidopsis roots, cytokinins initially determine cell-type boundaries among vascular stem cells and subsequently promote cell proliferation to establish vascular tissue symmetry. Although it is unknown whether and how the symmetry of initially defined boundaries is progressively refined under tissue growth in plants, such boundary shapes in animal tissues are regulated by cell fluidity, e.g., cell migration and intercalation, lacking in plant tissues. Here, we uncover that cell proliferation during vascular development produces anisotropic compressive stress, smoothing, and symmetrizing cell arrangement of the vascular-cell-type boundary. Mechanistically, the GATA transcription factor HANABA-TARANU cooperates with the type-B Arabidopsis response regulators to form an incoherent feedforward loop in cytokinin signaling. The incoherent feedforward loop fine-tunes the position and frequency of vascular cell proliferation, which in turn restricts the source of mechanical stress to the position distal and symmetric to the boundary. By combinatorial analyses of mechanical simulations and laser cell ablation, we show that the spatially constrained environment of vascular tissue efficiently entrains the stress orientation among the cells to produce a tissue-wide stress field. Together, our data indicate that the localized proliferation regulated by the cytokinin signaling circuit is decoded into a globally oriented mechanical stress to shape the vascular tissue symmetry, representing a reasonable mechanism controlling the boundary alignment and symmetry in tissue lacking cell fluidity.
abstract_zh: 对称的组织排列对植物维管组织的功能至关重要，例如长距离分子运输和侧生器官形成。在拟南芥根部的维管发育过程中，细胞分裂素最初决定维管干细胞中的细胞类型边界，随后促进细胞增殖以建立维管组织的对称性。尽管在植物中，初始定义的边界对称性是否以及如何在组织生长过程中逐步细化尚不清楚，但在动物组织中，此类边界形状受细胞流动性（例如细胞迁移和插入）调控，而植物组织缺乏这种流动性。在此，我们揭示维管发育过程中的细胞增殖产生各向异性压缩应力，平滑并对称化维管细胞类型边界的细胞排列。机制上，GATA转录因子HANABA-TARANU与B型拟南芥响应调节因子合作，在细胞分裂素信号传导中形成非相干前馈环。该非相干前馈环微调维管细胞增殖的位置和频率，进而将机械应力来源限制在边界远端且对称的位置。通过机械模拟和激光细胞消融的组合分析，我们表明维管组织的空间受限环境有效引导细胞间的应力方向，以产生组织范围的应力场。综合来看，我们的数据表明，由细胞分裂素信号回路调控的局部增殖被解码为全局定向的机械应力，以塑造维管组织对称性，这代表了在缺乏细胞流动性的组织中控制边界排列和对称性的合理机制。
